# Pull request

## What does this change?

## Type of change

- [ ] Content — new or corrected lessons, words, phrases, dialogues
- [ ] Accessibility — semantics, keyboard, contrast, screen-reader behaviour
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup
- [ ] Design / styling

## Checklist

- [ ] I opened the affected pages in a browser and they work
- [ ] `node --check` passes for every file I touched under `js/`
- [ ] `node tools/check-links.mjs` reports no broken links
- [ ] No emoji were introduced anywhere (the project uses the SVG sprite in `assets/icons.svg`)
- [ ] Any new Bodo string is in **Devanagari script** *and* carries a **romanisation**
- [ ] I did not invent Bodo forms; uncertain content is flagged rather than asserted
- [ ] Heading order is still correct (one `h1`, no skipped levels)
- [ ] I read `docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md` if I changed content
